title: pretty LUENA|Plus Size V Neck A-Line Sequin Formal Evening Dress with Sleeve
descriptionHtml:
This plus size sequin formal dress with 3/4 sleeves features a double deep V neckline, long sleeves and a flowy A-line skirt, the shiny sequins stripes decorate the top which gives a chic vibe. Perfect for all formal occasions, from evening party, cocktail, weddings to prom, homecoming and graduation!


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Closure: It is concealed Zipper up the Back.


Undergarments: It is not Padded , with Lining.


Fabric: Shell:100%Polyester? ?
Lining:100%Polyester.

Stretch: Fabric is Low Stretch.
